topics.title: About This Skin
topics.body: TELEGRAM is a phone-first SMACKTALK skin for reading long posts in a narrow column. Photographs and mosaics appear in the order the author placed them.

topics.title: Navigation and Photographs
topics.body: Open the text menu at the top right to browse the site. Tap an eligible photograph to enlarge it.

topics.title: Captions
topics.body: Use the Captions section in Skin Admin to set the colour, size, style, spacing, and alignment of captions beneath photographs.

topics.title: Variants
topics.body: The Dark and Light variants currently use the same palette as the default.
